name: Hyperion Four-Cheese Tortelloni (Hold Lemon)
whyItWorks: Soft egg-pasta tortelloni filled with blended four cheeses melts cleanly and is easy on mechanical digestion.
prepOrOrderInstructions: If you have a strict citrus guardrail, ask for the tortelloni served with plain melted butter/broth instead of the Meyer lemon sauce, and push the sun-dried tomato and baby spinach garnish to the side.
watchOuts: Sun-dried tomato skins and artichoke bracts
